incidents.description: Multiple failed login attempts followed by a successful login.
Login detected from an unfamiliar IP address.
A successful login occurred shortly after multiple failed authentication attempts. The user normally logs in during daytime hours.
A login was detected from an IP address with a suspicious reputation. The login used the correct credentials, and no failed attempts were recorded.
A successful login was followed by an unusual account settings change. No failed login attempts were detected. The user has not confirmed whether the activity was legitimate.
Several user accounts authenticated from the same source IP within a short period. The source IP is associated with a corporate network, but the activity is unusually concentrated.
A privileged account logged in from a previously unseen IP address. Authentication succeeded, and no suspicious activity has been confirmed.

An unusual login was detected. The authentication logs indicate a successful login, but the account activity service reports that no session was created. The source IP reputation service is unavailable.
